params.name: number
params.description: Integer to look up, or the keyword `random` to receive a random available fact.

params.name: json
params.description: Return the fact as a JSON object (`{ text, found, number, type, date?, year? }`) instead of plain text. Equivalent to setting the request `Content-Type: application/json` header.

params.name: fragment
params.description: Return the fact as a sentence fragment (lowercase, no terminal punctuation) suitable for embedding in a larger sentence.

params.name: notfound
params.description: Behavior when no fact exists for the requested number. `default` returns a generic message (overridable with `default`), `floor` rounds down to the nearest number with a fact, and `ceil` rounds up.

params.name: default
params.description: Custom message to return when no fact exists for the requested number.

params.name: min
params.description: Minimum value (inclusive) for random-number selection. Only meaningful when `number=random`.

params.name: max
params.description: Maximum value (inclusive) for random-number selection. Only meaningful when `number=random`.

params.name: callback
params.description: JSONP callback function name. The response is wrapped as `<callback>("<fact>")`.

params.name: write
params.description: Wrap the response in `document.write("<fact>")` so a single `<script src="...">` tag can render the fact inline. Equivalent to `callback=document.write`.

items.docs: Return a mathematical fact about the supplied integer. Use the keyword `random` to receive a random math fact.
